trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits a generally smooth topography near the median notch, transitioning to low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged serrations toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a convex curve from the median notch toward the distal tips, which terminate in swept-back, pointed vertices.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable high-intensity scarring and irregular pigmentation loss localized on the extreme distal tips of the fluke.
